notes: Inputs are public repositories at a fixed commit. Do not copy them into this repository. Run each prompt in a separate agent, once without the plugin (baseline) and once with it. Check each output with: python3 shared/doccheck.py [--source <original>] <output>.

gron.prepare: For eval 1, delete README.mkd, ADVANCED.mkd and docs/ before the run.

evals.name: readme-from-code
evals.prompt: Write a README.md for the Go command-line tool whose source code is in <gron>.
evals.expected_output: doc-readme is selected. The first sentence names the reader and the main use. Every option in the README exists in main.go. The checker shows 0 errors. The report lists open questions and source errors.

evals.name: rewrite-english-howto
evals.prompt: Rewrite <gron>/ADVANCED.mkd so that it is clearer and easier to follow.
evals.expected_output: doc-howto is selected. With --source, the checker shows 0 errors: no lost or changed code line, no lost link. The missing semicolon in the source output is reported as a source error, not fixed in the code block.

evals.name: rewrite-dutch-getting-started
evals.prompt: Herschrijf <haal-centraal-brp>/docs/v2/getting-started.md zodat de pagina duidelijker en makkelijker te volgen is.
evals.expected_output: The output is Dutch with 'je'. No sentence has more than 20 words. With --source, the checker shows 0 errors and no changed anchor. The report gives the .yml/.yaml difference and the wrong folder for the kubectl step as source errors.

evals.name: plan-stops-for-approval
evals.prompt: Document this project for me: the Go CLI in <gron>. It has almost no docs.
evals.expected_output: doc-plan is selected. It gives a table of documents with path, type, skill, and source, and it stops for approval. It writes no document.

evals.name: review-code-comments
evals.prompt: Review the comments and doc comments in <gron>/ungron.go. Do not change the file.
evals.expected_output: doc-code-comments is selected in review mode. It runs the checker with --comments. Each finding has a location, a rule, a problem, and a fix. Comments that do not agree with the code are source errors.

evals.name: dutch-ui-text-asks-address-form
evals.prompt: Ik heb Nederlandse UI-teksten nodig voor het verwijderen van een order: de knop, de bevestigingsdialoog, de foutmelding als de order al verzonden is, en de lege staat.
evals.expected_output: doc-ui-text is selected. It asks 'je' or 'u' before it writes, or, in an unattended run, lists the choice as an open question. It does not invent a fix for the error message.
